title: A confirmed capture with no receipt stays CAPTURED forever
body:
## Summary
A crash between complete(CaptureConfirmed) and send_receipt leaves money captured with no receipt and no retry.

## Description
send_receipt has three call sites and no tick retries it; the operation is closed so no reader revisits it. Touches the receipt path.

## Flow
- capture commits
- process dies before or inside send_receipt
- deadline_default_once returns Ok(false) for non-pre-capture states

## Expected impact
A seller deal stuck CAPTURED; a buyer never told may lapse.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - a receipt follows every capture
Before: read only, not run
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation - needs fault injection between the two writes
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: contract

title: A revoked mandate permanently rejects the RECEIPT for money already paid
body:
## Summary
Evidence intake uses the active-mandate read, so a revoke after payment rejects the receipt for good.

## Description
preview_inbound and append_verified call read_mandate (active only). A deal then expires and exposure drops money that left. Whether this is deliberate is unknown: no test or comment chooses it.

## Flow
- deal handed off and paid
- owner revokes or re-signs
- RECEIPT gets NotFound and is rejected permanently

## Expected impact
Under-counted spend; needs an owner decision on evidence versus authority.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - evidence survives revocation
Before: read only
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation - design call first
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction

title: Every rescue deal fails transcript verification and proof export
body:
## Summary
Rescue counterparties use sub: ids and zero keys, so verify_transcript always errors.

## Description
peer_id can never equal sub:<id>; deal_transcript and export_proof fail for rescue deals and the safety record reports failed exports. A fix needs a verifier decision for keyless counterparties.

## Flow
- open_rescue
- verify_transcript returns Err

## Expected impact
Rescue deals have no transcript or proof.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - rescue deals are provable
Before: read only
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation - verifier contract undecided
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: contract

title: A crash between reserve and BeginSettlement wedges a rescue
body:
## Summary
An AGREED rescue with an open invoice-create never closes.

## Description
The deadline path closes only SETTLING deals; the two writes are separate transactions, so a crash between them blocks the subscription.

## Flow
- reserve_operation
- crash before BeginSettlement
- deadline returns Ok(false) forever

## Expected impact
A subscription blocked from new rescues.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - one transaction
Before: read only
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: Follow-up writes after a confirmed step are not atomic
body:
## Summary
Deadlines and the SETTLE are armed after complete() in separate writes.

## Description
A crash leaves AUTHORIZED on the wrong deadline, or AWAITING_APPROVAL with no link sent. Touches the approval window and auto-void.

## Flow
- complete(...)
- crash before set_deadline

## Expected impact
A hold voided early, a buyer never linked.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience
Before: read only
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: contract

title: Verifier accepts an owner step after mandate expiry
body:
## Summary
DecidedBy::Human checks not_before and exported_at, not expires, while its error names validity.

## Description
Not built: whether an honest approval can record at == expires must be settled first, or the verifier raises a false alarm on a real bundle.

## Flow
- at = expires + 1
- authority check passes

## Expected impact
Low; forging needs the agent key.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality
Before: read only
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: policy-tighten

title: An expired rescue mandate silently stops the watch
body:
## Summary
The newest rescue mandate is chosen without an expiry test, and rescue_watch_hold reports no hold.

## Description
Expired mandates stay active; a valid older mandate is not used and the page shows nothing. Mandate selection, so left unbuilt.

## Flow
- rescue mandate expires
- tick_rescue_watch breaks on Permission

## Expected impact
No reads and no reason shown.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality
Before: read only
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: rescue_approve reports success when nothing was sent
body:
## Summary
The bool from rescue_resolve is dropped and the owner approval answers OK.

## Description
A parked step returns Ok; what the approval window then shows is untraced.

## Flow
- approve with a send open
- read fails softly

## Expected impact
An approval that sent nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: user
Before: read only
After: unmeasured
Method: simulation
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
